sentences.text: The product note says that for individual borrowers on floating-rate loans for non-business purposes, no foreclosure charge applies.
The home loan agreement says a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding applies on foreclosure or pre-payment, and a copied version says 3% applies.
So the in-force documents do not agree on foreclosure charges for this borrower type and loan purpose.

I did not find a separate Retail Loan Policy document in the evidence set, and the RBI pre-payment-charge directions that would otherwise address this topic are marked superseded or outside confirmed applicability here.
